Subject: Feature inference costing audit & payback — next steps

Hi Ellis / Sana —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks I promised to capture so we can align the unit-econ work and procurement path: 

Summary of what we heard (verbatim high level):
- Primary use: clinical summarization + triage suggestions inside clinician workflow (two features).
- Target concurrency: light (10–30 agents/day per clinic) but steady daily usage across ~120 clinics in pilot.
- Latency SLO: sub-800ms median for summarization path; 1s acceptable for triage suggestions.

Asks / data needed to run a focused unit-econ audit (please fill or confirm):
1) Token volume range (monthly): low / expected / high. If you can provide tokens per call or an average tokens-per-feature, that helps a ton.
2) Target budget envelope (monthly or $/1M tokens target). If you have a ceiling and a preferred target, list both.
3) Business-side targets: target $/feature (what you’d like each summarization or triage suggestion to net after infra cost), CAC payback target in months, and minimum gross margin target on the feature.
4) Procurement timeline and legal gate: do you have a standard PO / SOW path, and any deadlines?

I attached our unit-econ template to make #1–#3 quick to populate. Also attaching the call recording for reference.

Proposed next steps:
- You fill the unit-econ template and send back by EOD Thu (Apr 1).
- We will run a short costing audit and return a preliminary $/1M token estimate and feature-level mapping within 48 hours of receiving the sheet.
- Schedule a 45-minute follow-up to review the audit, discuss pilot pricing bands, and map CAC/payback scenarios (I proposed Wed Apr 6 at 10am PT — please confirm).

Ben (cc) will draft a suggested pilot band once we have token ranges — he can also flag any discounts/credits for an initial 6–8 week proof-of-value.

Thanks — appreciate the collaborative review here.

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Rafael — thanks for the summary and the template. Quick answers inline and a few raw numbers to start the audit: 

Token volumes (current estimate for pilot, monthly):
- Summarization feature: 45k calls/month, avg ~4.2k tokens per call (input + output) => ~189M tokens/month.
- Triage suggestions: 60k calls/month, avg ~800 tokens/call => ~48M tokens/month.
- Combined expected: ~237M tokens/month.
- High case (scale): ~600M tokens/month.

Budget: we have an initial pilot budget range of $9k–$18k/month for API costs. Stretch to $30k/month if the ROI is compelling and latency/SLA is proven. Our procurement prefers unit targets, e.g., ~$200–$300 per 1M tokens as the internal goal, but that's negotiable.

Business targets:
- Target $/feature (net): $0.35 per summarized note (target margin after infra)
- CAC payback: 6–9 months preferred
- Minimum gross margin on feature: 40%

Procurement: fast lane — we can do a PO for a pilot within 2–3 weeks if commercial terms are clear.

I'll populate the template this afternoon and send back. Happy to keep Apr 6 for a follow-up; leaning toward 10am PT.

Cheers,
Ellis

Ellis — great numbers, thanks for the quick turnaround. I ran a very quick back-of-envelope using your expected tokens to translate into $/feature and rough CAC implications so we have something to discuss on Wed.

Top-line (using expected 237M tokens / month):
- If target is $250 per 1M tokens => infra cost ~ $250 * 237 = $59,250/month (gross simplification; we’ll optimize with batching/cache/quantization).
- Translate to $/feature: combined features = 105k calls/month. So infra cost per call ~ $59,250 / 105k = ~$0.56 per call.
- You’re targeting $0.35 net per summarized note — that implies either a lower infra unit cost target (~$0.20/call) OR ops/revenue per call higher to preserve margin.

CAC payback quick mapping (very rough):
- If your ARR contribution per active clinic per month assumes $X (please confirm), we can backsolve the max acceptable acquisition cost to hit 6–9 months payback.

Pilot pricing suggestion (to meet your margin / payback goals):
- Option A (conservative): Offer pilot band $160–$220 / 1M tokens for first 8 weeks + $5k pilot credit.
- Option B (value): $100–$150 / 1M tokens for first 4 weeks (heavy credit) then step to $180 / 1M tokens.

Next asks from our side to make the audit precise:
- Per-feature breakdown of tokens per call (you provided averages; if you can paste per-feature deltas in the sheet that's ideal).
- Expected ARR per clinic or average revenue per active user — used to calculate CAC payback.

I'll put these two pilot band proposals in a short paper and share ahead of Wed so legal/procurement can see the initial commercial shapes. Rafael — if you want, I can include an explicit margin table showing gross margin vs token price and a CAC payback slider.

-Ben
